newsitem.title: BERMUDA: CAT Ltd forms new finite reinsurer Enterprise Re.
newsitem.headline: CAT Ltd forms new finite reinsurer Enterprise Re.

text.p: CAT Ltd said it and other investors have formed a new company to provide finite reinsurance, insurance and strategic risk financing and have capitalized it with an initial $100 million in equity.
Other investors in the new company, Enterprise Reinsurance Ltd, include Employers Reinsurance Corp, Chubb Corp, and Morgan Stanley Group Inc, the founder and lead investor of CAT Ltd, CAT Ltd said.
CAT Ltd said its chief executive Paul Hasse and president Charles Kline will serve as co-chairmen of the new company and its parent corporation, Enterprise Reinsurance Holding Corp.
Cat Ltd said Enterprise Re was formed by its investors in response to increased client demand for structured solutions for property, casualty, life and health insurance risks.
Its underwriting operations, conducted through Enterprise Reinsurance Ltd, are based in Bermuda.
Enterprise Re is headquartered in the United States.

"Our strategic partners are premier organizations in their respective fields and provide us broad distribution and syndication capabilities and access to insureds, insurance companies, and financial markets worldwide," Enterprise Re president Jonathan Roberts said.

He said Enterprise Re will design strategic risk financing solutions to a client's financial goals, such as protecting earnings or surplus from volatility or providing capital for acquisitions or growth.
Property-casualty, life and health insurers as well as large commercial insured will be able to use Enterprise Re's skills for their own financial planning, he said.
Cat Ltd said Roberts joined Enterprise Re from American International Group Inc, where he headed the firm's worldwide effort in large strategic risk financing transactions.
Cat Ltd said he is one of the pioneers in the field, having underwritten highly structured insurance and reinsurance transactions since 1982.
Enterprise Re's owners are contributing capital, expertise, and market access to the company, CAT Ltd said.
Hamilton Services Ltd, an affiliate of CAT, is providing technologies for risk analysis and portfolio management.

Employers Re, the third largest general reinsurer worldwide, will utilize Enterprise's expertise in this specialized line of business to develop and offer financial reinsurance solutions to its client base.
Warren, N.J.-based Chubb will work closely with Enterprise Re on a global basis to create new opportunities in strategic risk financing in the insurance market, CAT Ltd said.
